## What changed and why

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link the related issue, if any.

## Validation

List the checks you actually ran and their results. Include screenshots for UI changes and note the browsers, screen sizes, and themes checked.

## Deployment or compatibility notes

Describe migrations, configuration changes, dependency changes, or upgrade steps. Write “None” if not applicable.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change follows the current product and design conventions.
- [ ] Relevant behavior and authorization checks are included or updated.
- [ ] Documentation reflects any changed setup or usage.
- [ ] No credentials, private content, or personal data are included.
- [ ] Any new third-party assets have appropriate licenses and attribution.
